name.en: Ilzam Bāb Rabbik - Hold Fast to the Door of Your Lord

ara: لَا يَكْثُرُ هَمُّكْ مَا قُدِّرْ يَكُونْ
إِلْزَمْ بَابْ رَبِّكْ وَاتْرُكْ كُلَّ دُونْ
فَوِّضْ لُهْ أُمُورَكْ وَحْسِنْ فِي الظُّنُونْ
لَوْ وَلِمْ وَكَيْفَ قَوْلُ ذِي الْحَمَقْ
en: lā yakthuru hammuk mā quddir yakūn
ilzam bāb rabbik wa-truk kulla dūn
wa-sʾalhu s-salāmah min dāri l-futūn
lā yaḍīqu ṣadruk fa-l-ḥādith yahūn
allāhu l-muqaddir wa-l-ʿālam shuʾūn
fikrak wa-khtiyārak daʿhumā warāk
wa-t-tadbīr ayḍan wa-shhad man barāk
mawlāka l-muhaymin innahū yarāk
fawwiḍ luh umūrak wa-ḥsin fi ẓ-ẓunūn
law wa-lim wa-kayfa qawlu dhi l-ḥamaq
yaʿtariḍ ʿala llāhi lladhī khalaq
wa-qaḍā wa-qaddar kulla shay bi-ḥaqq
yā qalbī tanabbah wa-truki l-mujūn
qad ḍamin taʿālā bi-r-rizqi l-qawām
fi l-kitābi l-munzal nūran li-l-anām
fa-r-riḍā farīḍah wa-s-sakhaṭ ḥarām
wa-l-qunūʿ rāḥah wa-ṭ-ṭamaʿ junūn
anta wa-l-khalāʾiq kulluhum ʿabīd
wa-l-ilāhu fīnā yafʿal mā yurīd
hammuk wa-ghtimāmuk wayḥak mā yufīd
al-qaḍā taqaddam fa-ghnami s-sukūn
alladhī li-ghayrik lā yaṣil ilayk
wa-lladhī qusim lak ḥāṣilun ladayk
fa-shtaghil bi-rabbik wa-lladhī ʿalayk
fī farḍi l-ḥaqīqah wa-sh-sharʿi l-maṣūn
sharʿi l-muṣṭafā al-hādi l-bashīr
khatmi l-anbiyāʾi l-badri l-munīr
ṣalla llāhu ʿalayhi r-rabbu l-qadīr
mā rīḥu ṣ-ṣabā mālat bi-l-ghuṣūn
Let not your worries overwhelm you; whatever was ordained will come to pass
Cling to the door of your Lord, leave everything else aside
Ask Him for safety from the abode of tribulations
Let not your heart be restricted, every temporal thing will soon fade
Allah is the Ordainer, and this world is His affair
Your thoughts and preferences, leave them behind
Together with your plans. And witness the One who created you alone
Your Patron Lord, the Guardian, indeed He sees you
Entrust all your affairs to Him, and then maintain the best of opinions
If? Why? How? Is the speech of fools
Opposing Allah, the One who created [everything]
And [the One who] preordained and decreed everything in truth
O my heart take heed, and abandon your impertinence
The Exalted has guaranteed all necessary provisions
In the Revealed Book, a light for all creation
So contentment [with the decree] is obligatory, and discontent forbidden
Frugality in everything is comfort, while covetousness is insanity
You and the whole of creation are all mere servants [of Allah]
And the Lord does to us whatever He wills
Your worries and sorrows – woe to you – bring you no benefit
The decree has already foregone, so seize this tranquility
That which is meant for others will never come to you
And that which has been apportioned for you will soon be attained
So occupy yourself solely with your Lord and what is required of you
With regards to the obligatory realities and the protected Sacred Law
The Law of the Chosen One, the Guide, the Bringer of Glad Tidings
The Seal of Prophets, the Illumined Full Moon
The Blessings of Allah, the All-Powerful Lord, be upon him
So long as the morning breeze sways branches
